known_limitation: This is a derived action-sequence probe, not evidence of a separately trained time-regression head. It is included because task 20's target is deterministically derivable from a sequence of action labels.
normalization_policy: Rows are grouped by episode and sorted by center-window start frame. The target and prediction are frames until the next action-label change, capped at 200 frames.
score_policy: Derived from existing verified held-out action predictions. The model did not emit a direct scalar time-to-transition value; predicted boundary timing is computed from changes in its predicted action sequence and compared with the true held-out action-boundary timing.
title: Cosmos3-Super Reasoner Time-to-Transition Action-Sequence Probe
